sloka: त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ।दिष्ट्या ते निहता राम महावीर्या निशाचराः ।। ७.१.२३ ॥
transliteration: triśirāścātikāyaśca devāntakanarāntakau ।diṣṭyā te nihatā rāma mahāvīryā niśācarāḥ ।। 7.1.23 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have killed those extremely powerful demons Trishira, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka.
